hierarchy.title: Branch structure
hierarchy.namesAfterUnlock: Names are not shown here. The roster is what the branch PIN protects — unlock the kiosk and everyone appears, grouped by these same tiers.

role.supervisor: Runs the branch. Approves overtime, corrects the log, changes the shift.
role.sales_leader: Leads the floor team. Adds staff and corrects the branch log.
role.sales_executive: Sells and sees the branch board for the day.
role.sales_associate: Clocks in and out at this kiosk.

staffAuth.ownRecordsOnly: Your PIN opens your own records only.

staffDash.autoClose: This screen closes itself after a minute so the next person does not see your records.

overtime.title: Overtime
overtime.tapBeforePin: Tap this before entering your PIN
overtime.workedPast: You worked {{duration}} past the end of your shift.
overtime.notPastShiftEnd: Your shift has not finished yet, so there is no overtime to claim.
overtime.withinGrace: The first {{count}} minutes after the shift end are not counted as overtime.
overtime.sessionOpen: Overtime is worked out when you clock out.
overtime.none: No overtime available for this shift.
overtime.cappedNotice: That is over the {{cap}} daily limit, so {{cap}} will be recorded and a supervisor will review the rest.

location.blockedDetail: Attendance can only be logged at the shop, so the browser needs location access. Enable it in the site settings, then try again.
location.tooFarDetail: You need to be within {{radius}} m. You are about {{over}} m outside that.
location.imprecise: Signal is too weak to confirm
location.impreciseDetail: The location is only accurate to about {{accuracy}} m, and we need {{required}} m or better. Step closer to a window or door and wait a moment.
location.wrongNetworkDetail: You appear to be at the shop but on a different network. Connect to the shop Wi-Fi and try again.
location.devBypassDetail: Developer mode is on. Geofencing and the network check are disabled.
location.networkUnverified: The network could not be confirmed from this device. The punch will still be checked against the shop network by the server.
location.borderline: You are close to the edge of the allowed area. Move a little closer to the shop if the check fails.

errors.wrongBranchPin: That is not the PIN for this branch.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
errors.noServer: Cannot reach the server. Check the connection.
errors.anonymousDisabled: Turn on Anonymous sign-in in Firebase → Authentication → Sign-in method. The kiosk needs some identity before Firestore will let it read the roster.
errors.notDeployed: PIN checking is not set up on the server yet. Deploy the verifyBranchPin function, or set VITE_ALLOW_CLIENT_PUNCH=true for local testing.
errors.timeout: The server did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
errors.rulesNotDeployed: This tablet is signed in but Firestore is refusing to send the roster — the security rules have not been deployed for the attendance collections. Run `npm run merge:rules` and publish the result.
errors.kioskSessionExpired: This tablet's sign-in has expired. Lock the kiosk and unlock it again with the branch PIN — the roster cannot be read without an identity.
errors.indexMissing: The roster query needs a Firestore index that has not been created yet. Run `firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes`, or open the link in the message below — it creates exactly the right index. Indexes take a minute or two to build.
errors.noPinSet: No PIN has been set for you yet. Ask a supervisor to set one.
errors.pinUnreadable: Firestore is refusing to read or write PINs. This is the rules, not the PIN: run `npm run merge:rules`, paste firestore.rules.merged into Firebase Console → Firestore → Rules, and Publish.

admin.title: Attendance
admin.signInSubtitle: Attendance reporting for Win, Pwint and Yangon
admin.notAboutAccount: This is not about your account — sign-in did not get that far.
admin.switchAccounts: Sign out of that Google account, or switch accounts, and try again.
admin.teamIntro: Grouped by seniority. Tap anyone to correct a day or take them off the system; use the gear on a branch to change its shift, grace windows and radius.
admin.noRosterData: No roster data for this range
admin.shiftsWithPunch: {{present}} of {{expected}} expected shifts had a punch
admin.noOvertimeMatched: The overtime-only filter is on and nothing matched.
admin.noOvertimeClaimed: Nobody claimed overtime in this range.
admin.notConfigured: Firebase is not configured. Copy .env.example to .env, fill in the project values and restart the dev server.
admin.staffDoNotSignIn: Shop staff do not sign in here —
admin.employeeManagementIntro: Every employee, their PIN and their details. A PIN is only fetched when you open the eye — it is never loaded with the table.
admin.pinLeaveBlank: Leave blank to keep the current PIN. Type four digits to replace it.
admin.pinFourDigits: The PIN must be exactly 4 digits.
admin.pinReserved: That PIN is reserved by the system. Choose another.
